methods.label: Edge-on projection
methods.explanation: When the circular piece is perpendicular to the projection plane, the projection rays lie in the plane of the circular piece. The entire piece projects onto a line segment (whose length equals the diameter).
methods.levelReason: The argument uses the Grade 9 definition of orthographic projection and elementary circle terminology.
